proposed.explanation: Elevation alone may be insufficient if flood levels exceed 1 meter; check valves provide active protection regardless of elevation. Pipe diameter does not address contamination prevention; it affects flow rate only. Pipe material (copper vs. steel) does not prevent contamination from backflow or floodwater ingress. Per the article, water supply intakes in flood-prone buildings must be elevated above flood level OR equipped with check valves and automatic shutoff to prevent contamination from backflow during utility main failures. Check valves and automatic shutoffs are essential safeguards. Check valves and automatic shutoff systems prevent contamination of water supplies during floods by blocking backflow and ingress.
